name: cache-warm
description: Keeps the prompt cache of idle Claude Code sessions warm with activity-aware keep-alive pings. Configurable interval, on/off switch, idle cap, cost estimates, web dashboard.

enabled.title: Warming on
enabled.description: Master switch. Also switchable any time with /cache-warm:on and /cache-warm:off.

warm_when.title: Warm a session
warm_when.description: background-work: only while a subagent or background task is running in it (recommended). always: any idle session.

interval_minutes.title: Ping interval (minutes)
interval_minutes.description: auto = 50 on a 1-hour cache, 4 on a 5-minute cache. Otherwise a number from 1 to 59, shorter than your cache TTL.

max_idle_minutes.title: Stop after idle (minutes)
max_idle_minutes.description: Stop pinging a session once you have been away this long. 0 = never stop.

min_context_tokens.title: Skip sessions below (tokens)
min_context_tokens.description: Small contexts are cheap to rebuild; do not warm them.

fallback_cron.title: In-session fallback when no monitor
fallback_cron.description: If Claude Code did not start the plugin monitor for a session, ask Claude once to schedule an in-session keep-alive task instead (one tool call).
